description: The Institute of Chartered Accountancy of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act. No 15 of 1995, Publication under Section 4(2)
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the adoption of an amendment (Covid-19-Related Rent Concessions) to the Sri Lanka Financial Reporting Standard (SLFRS) 16 Leases. It is a regulatory update issued under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. The content deals with legal/regulatory matters concerning accounting standards and their effective dates, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
